GraceTechnology.Runtime: Bun >=1.4.4-canary.1 (engines.bun in package.json, enforced by scripts/check-bun-version.ts)
GraceTechnology.Framework: Bun workspaces (apps/*, packages/*); no application framework yet
GraceTechnology.TestingStack: bun test; bun check -b for types; bun lint and bun fmt configured in bunfig.toml
GraceTechnology.Observability: None yet; there is no runtime service.

OperationalConstraints.Constraint: Add a dependency only with owner approval, pinned exactly, with supply-chain checks.
bun run verify must pass before review, accept and merge; the pre-commit hook and Spec Kitty's review gate enforce it.
